provenance: Original minimal synthetic fixtures authored for chematic on 2026-10-22; no third-party source copied.
minimization: Six short records isolate atom order, AutoDock element aliases, explicit H, finite numeric precision, charge semantics and line endings.

oracle.settings: Exact parsed binary64 coordinates in angstrom and partial charges in elementary charge; no tolerance for API arrays. PDBQT output is rounded to three decimals, absolute tolerance 0.000500000001.

normalization: UTF-8, CRLF to LF, otherwise exact input string; SHA-256 per case
